description: Creates an S7 connection between two devices. Guard G2: requires ≥2 CONSISTENT CPUs (compile clean) — a bare CPU fails. On error, the envelope's 'details' carries the diagnostic (or use tia_connections_diagnose). Maps to POST /connections. M-off.

localDevice.description: local device station name from tia_devices.name or tia_plcs.device, not the PLC software name

partnerDevice.description: partner device station name from tia_devices.name or tia_plcs.device, not the PLC software name

name: tia_connection_create
title: TIA — create S7 connection
